 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Minnesota Timberwolves star Anthony Edwards needs an arthroscopic procedure on his right knee and could miss up to two months, ESPN's Shams Charania reports .
 Edwards was listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Cavaliers due to right knee injury management, but played in the game and scored 47 points. He was also initially listed as questionable for Wednesday's upcoming game against the Golden State Warriors that he will now miss.
 The news is difficult blow for one of the game's brightest stars and a 3-1 Timberwolves team seeking to ascend to championship contention this season.
 This story will be updated.
